source_summary: Ink-and-color Chinese landscape with blue-green mountains, misty distant peaks, dense and leafless trees, small scholar figures, foreground boulders, a stream bank, and a low stone bridge; inscriptions and seals are excluded.

motifs.name: layered_blue_green_mountains
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper-left and central mountain mass: rounded layered peaks and sloping rock faces painted in pale grey, blue-green wash, and soft ink contours, including the visible white reserve channels and ridge-top texture but excluding calligraphy, seals, and foreground tree branches.
must_preserve: soft grey contour lines defining rounded peaks
white unpainted ravines and mist gaps
subtle darker ink accents along ridges

motifs.name: dark_ridge_forest_belt
motifs.description: Isolate the dark clustered foliage scattered across the central mountain ridge, including blotchy tree crowns and small shrub masses that sit on the slopes, separated from the pale mountain forms behind them.
must_preserve: clustered crown rhythm across the ridge
small broken brush marks suggesting shrubs

motifs.name: misty_right_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale right-side distant peaks emerging from blank mist: soft vertical rock silhouettes behind the middle trees and bridge area, with feathered wash edges and minimal interior linework, excluding the inscription columns above.
must_preserve: thin contour outlines on peak edges
faint interior texture only where visible

motifs.name: left_leafless_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the tall leafless foreground tree at the left edge, including its dark trunk, twisting lower roots, and angular branching canopy that spreads into the middle-left, but not the nearby scholar figures or mountain wash behind it.
must_preserve: black ink trunk with knotted bends
branch tips tapering into empty space

motifs.name: central_winter_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the central band of bare winter trees and blue-green shrub masses across the midground, including the twisting thin trunks, interlaced branches, and dark foliage clumps, while excluding the large foreground boulder and distant mountains.
must_preserve: twisting pale trunks with ink outlines
layered transparency of branches over wash

motifs.name: scholar_pair_under_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the two small scholar figures near the lower-left base of the tree: seated/standing figures in pale robes with delicate facial and hand lines, one with a small warm color accent, excluding the adjacent tree trunk and rock mass as much as possible.
must_preserve: scale relationship between the two figures

motifs.name: foreground_ink_boulders
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground boulder group occupying the lower center-left: massive rounded rocks with dark ink pooling, pale grey-green planes, grass tufts at the base, and dry-brush texture, excluding the scholar figures and bridge.
must_preserve: heavy black ink washes in crevices
dark mossy blotches on upper surfaces
short grass strokes along the base

motifs.name: right_stone_bridge_streambank
motifs.description: Isolate the low arched stone bridge and adjoining rocky stream bank at the lower right, including the row of small stones along the bridge edge, the vertical support/wash beneath, nearby grasses, and water-margin strokes, excluding right-edge seals.
must_preserve: small bead-like stone marks along the bridge top
thin grass strokes at the water edge
pale water reserve and soft horizontal wash marks

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
